about: Who was first on each keyed fact: for each fact (IPMA's red wind, the alert, Web Summit's decision ...), each outlet's first item on it and the minutes after the primary source. From incident.media@'s first-on-each-fact.json; the matching is by pattern, so each row is analysis (labelled hypothesis). Only outlets whose feeds could be read are here. Built by tools/graph-build.mjs from the incident's JSON; every row carries label, source, read and origin. Not a warning service.
